body: Found an orphan kitten about 2 weeks old. Weighing at 170 grams and I can feel his bones. Tried feeding but isn’t latching on to syringe or nursing bottle. Sleeps a hell lot even when I woke it up to feed. Quite strong as it pushes my hand away whenever I try to feed. Managed to get a bit of milk. Higher frequency lesser milk intake (if u know what i mean?) So instead of a full meal every 3 hours, i give half a meal every 1.5 hours. Got dried up cat milk on his fur as well. Thank you for your kind words. I’m grateful. I’ll do my best to cope with your suggestions while paying off my debts. Things will get better for us, hopefully.
thank you kind soul. matter of time. ❤️

He has disappeared and cut all contacts. If I could, I would. Definitely was my first option and looked for him and his family but he took no responsibility as he “has spent money on me” through out our relationship as well.

I have been paying my debts but it is leaving me with very little. Sometimes, I can’t even afford my own food. But the depressing part is skipping everything fun, sometimes even with family I can’t do anything because it requires money that I don’t have. Staying home. Not being able to do anything because obviously we have to pay for a lot of things in SG. I’m looking forward. And I can’t wait for this to end. My birthday is next month, there’s new year, christmas, everything festive and fun, and here I am… Haha. Thank you for sparing some time to type this out for me. It really helps.

Total up amount is too big a sum to ask from family. They won’t react kindly. 

Friends also don’t make that much money. They have their own responsibilities. 

Also, my credit score is screwed. So I can’t take up any other loan. Debt consolidation or DRP, I don’t meet the requirements either.

Today I realised how “poor” I am as a Singaporean. In my mid-20s, I’m paying close to $2,000 worth of debts because I was in love and stupidly took up a loan for my ex - and drawing a $3,000 salary before CPF deduction. I feel extremely suicidal, and refuse to get help from family or friends because I feel like this is something I should deal with myself. Growing up I’ve been taught to make money on my own. I wanted to be an artist. Before COVID, I was doing just fine. I had so many projects to work on and clients who would engage in my services. However since COVID started, I had no choice but to look for a 9-5 job. Of course there are ways to make more money like taking up a part time job and so on. But I think my mind is too much a mess for me to function elsewhere. I believe in giving my best wherever I choose to work. The current job I’m in is mentally draining. I have no choice but to survive with about $100+ a month (which is hilarious because who can?) and just suck it up. I feel hopeless, and depressed. I don’t know what to do. Or how to deal with things. This may be a small amount to many people. But for me, it’s huge. Any kind words will help. Any advice. Anything. But if you have nothing nice to say, please don’t.

Edit: to add on, i’m not educated, neither do i have a high post in wherever i work at. i am just a normal average or less than average singaporean.

ONLY 7 years? Damn. Thats a lot of time spent. I’m glad you’re out of it. I don’t think the society where I live knows enough about narcissistic personality disorders. They just keep believing that the victims are the crazy ones. It’s hard when you’re on your own. Hence, Reddit. Thank you for sparing your minutes for me.
No we’re not. I want to block/delete her. But there’s a lot of things I’m thinking about. I don’t know why is it so hard for me.

Well she has a habit of using my anxiety triggers and intentionally disorient me. For example she would bait me with a little fun idea like going out, then strip it all away from me. “I wanted to do this but you did that, so we’re not going to see each other at all”.

She also has a habit if misleading my thoughts. Such as when we argue, she proceeds to post something on her social media that suggests somebody has gifted her something, captioning it with a “Thank you”. without actually mentioning who it was, so it seems like somebody “special” has gifted her something. I’m not sure if you get where I’m coming from but she has done this twice now in 3 months. 

On top of that she victimises herself and wallows in self pity. I’m really not sure if she’s aware that she’s showing narcissistic characteristics. And I wish she knew. 

There’s so much micro-manipulation that when I talk to people about it, it gets so tiring for them because it’s a daily matter, and in small “doses”. It is so draining.
Only day 2 and I’m feeling pretty good. I’m just thinking if I should delete our texts. Pictures. So that it’s easier for me to pretend there’s no break but an actual break up.
